responsibility: Top-level makefile fragment that integrates the Go frontend into GCC’s build, test, documentation, staging, and install machinery. It defines how the internal compiler executable `go1` and the driver `gccgo` are linked, enumerates the Go frontend object files, supplies Go-specific include and warning flags, wires in Texinfo/manual generation from `gccgo.texi`, and provides the standard `go.*` hooks used by the GCC toplevel build for cross builds, cleaning, tagging, tests, and installation of the compiler binary and docs.
